description: Saskatoon Police Service held Indigenous recruiting day.
SPS adopted policy supporting living organ donors.
Police officers rode bikes for mental health awareness.

chips.text: Emergency services personnel face mental health challenges.

description: Saskatoon Police Chief McBride received CACP appreciation for summit participation.

chips.text: Chief McBride and other police service members attended the summit.

description: Police service finances are on track as of August 31.
Operating and capital activities are within approved funding.
Capital reserves of $3.5 million support the 10-year capital plan.

chips.text: Police service received $7.3 million revenue by August 31.
Councillor suggested showing budget expended percentage in future reports.

description: The 2027 Police Budget totals $149.9 million, up $7.7 million.
It includes 33 new full-time employees, 4 for transit policing.
The budget allocates $4.8 million for capital projects and reserves.

chips.text: Provincial funding will add 13 patrol constables in 2027.
Police population is "very lean" despite approved funding for more officers.
Transit safety operators and riders feel safer due to police presence.
Social services offered assistance to transit riders unable to pay fares.
